title: Letter to HKAB: Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments: consultation on revised completion instructions
summary: On 4 September 2025, HKMA wrote to the Hong Kong Association of Banks (HKAB) with a consultation titled 'Cryptoassets standard and other miscellaneous amendments,' seeking feedback on revised completion instructions -- the detailed guidance Authorized Institutions follow when filling in HKMA banking return forms. It is one of a running series of technical letters (covering individual return templates, explanatory notes, and completion instructions) through which HKMA has been implementing a new prudential standard for banks' cryptoasset exposures since mid-2025. The specific instructions this particular letter proposes to revise could not be confirmed against the letter's own text: HKMA's document repository (brdr.hkma.gov.hk) returned a server error (HTTP 503) on every attempt to retrieve it, both when this card was drafted and during independent verification. The title and date above, however, are corroborated by HKMA's own regulatory consultations RSS feed listing for this item, independently of the inaccessible document page.
why_it_matters: This is one of a series of technical consultation letters through which HKMA is rolling out a new prudential 'Cryptoassets standard' governing how licensed banks must capitalise and report their exposure to cryptoassets -- relevant to anyone tracking how, not just whether, Hong Kong regulates banks' crypto exposure. For a newcomer: this particular document is a narrow technical step (revised completion instructions for a return form) rather than a new policy in its own right.
